title: Gregale OpenAPI Import Structural Check
description: Structural-minimum JSON Schema for OpenAPI documents imported via POST /v1/apps/{slug}/openapi. This is NOT the full OpenAPI 3.1 meta-schema (the canonical OAI repo no longer hosts schema.json — see OAI/OpenAPI-Specification issue #4149 from 2024-10); it pins the load-bearing shape requirements the apid layer needs for abuse prevention. Customers get a structural guarantee (required fields present, version enum, paths is an object); the full meta-schema can be layered in later without API changes.

openapi.description: OpenAPI version. Pinned to the seven versions whose meta-schemas Gregale accepts.

paths.description: Paths object — keys are URL templates, values are path items. Empty {} is allowed (declaration-only doc).
